strings.jp: 「ワシが相手をしてやろうぞ」
strings.en: I shall be your opponent.
Then, here I come.
My turn, it seems.

strings.jp: 「あえて苦難の道を選ぶか。それも善哉」
strings.en: You choose the path of hardship?/　That, too, is good.

strings.jp: 「さあて、どこまで耐えおるかのう」
strings.en: Now then, how long will you endure?

strings.jp: 「生々流転の輪を回すとするかのう」
strings.en: Let us turn the wheel of endless change.

strings.jp: 「いかなる意志も事象も、太極の内」
strings.en: All will and events lie within the Taiji.

strings.jp: 「事に従うか、抗うか……/　お主らの思うままにするがよい」
strings.en: Submit to fate, or defy it.../　Do as you see fit.

strings.jp: 「仙道に沿わぬか。それも善哉」
strings.en: You stray from the sage's path?/　That, too, is good.

strings.jp: 「善き実が結べば、それで良いのじゃ」
strings.en: So long as good fruit is borne, all is well.

strings.jp: 「無為自然、有為転変……いずれも然り」
strings.en: Nonaction, ceaseless change.../　Both hold true.
Here I come, pilot of Seiryu.

strings.jp: 「強念者よ、意のままに戦うがよい」
strings.en: Strong psychic, fight as you will.
Here I come, pilot of Byakko.

strings.jp: 「尸解をよしとせぬか。それも善哉」
strings.en: You refuse to shed your mortal shell?/　That, too, is good.

strings.jp: 「お主らが真理に達するのであれば、/　それも善哉」
strings.en: If you can reach the ultimate truth,/　that, too, is good.

strings.jp: 「ワシに抗うか、ククル。それも善哉」
strings.en: You defy me, Kukuru? That, too, is good.

strings.jp: 「偽魂が人道を往く……それも善哉」
strings.en: A false soul walking the path of man.../　That, too, is good.

strings.jp: 「偽魂も道を究めれば、真魂となろう」
strings.en: Even a false soul, mastering the Way,/　may become a true soul.

strings.jp: 「青龍……我らの下に戻らぬか。それも善哉」
strings.en: Seiryu... You won't return to us?/　That, too, is good.

strings.jp: 「白虎よ、そこがお主の在所か。それも善哉」
strings.en: Byakko, is that where you belong?/　That, too, is good.
Then, let us go with the flow.
Give and take, as they say.
I'll make the first move.
Take this in return, BuJakuOh!
Take this in return, BuOhKi!
Hmm, it's time I withdrew.

strings.jp: 「フワッハッハッハ！　善き哉、善き哉！」
strings.en: Bwahahaha! Splendid, splendid!

strings.jp: 「フワッハッハ！　やりおるわい！」
strings.en: Bwahaha! Not bad at all!
Oho, well, well!

strings.jp: 「人の身でここまでやるとはの！」
strings.en: To think a mere human could do this much!

strings.jp: 「フハハハ！　まさになすがままじゃのう！」
strings.en: Fuhahaha!/　Truly, whatever will be, will be!

strings.jp: 「これは刮眼せねばならんのう」
strings.en: Now this calls for a closer look.

strings.jp: 「おおっ、これはぬかったのう」
strings.en: Ooh, I've been careless.
I, Taihoku, let my guard down.

strings.jp: 「玄武の守りを崩すとは……善哉、善哉」
strings.en: To breach Genbu's defense.../　Splendid, splendid.

strings.jp: 「ふむう……/　夏喃が目を付けただけのことはあるわ」
strings.en: Hmm.../　No wonder Kanan took an interest in you.

strings.jp: 「白虎の操者よ、よい気迫じゃ」
strings.en: Pilot of Byakko, you show fine Drive.

strings.jp: 「ふむう、よい念を持っておる」
strings.en: Hmm, your will is strong.

strings.jp: 「その力、人のために使うか。それも善哉」
strings.en: You use that power for others?/　That, too, is good.

strings.jp: 「ほほう、玄武を超えるか、青龍よ！」
strings.en: Oho, you surpass Genbu, Seiryu!

strings.jp: 「うむ！　四神の力、しかと見た！」
strings.en: Yes! I've seen the power of the Four Gods!

strings.jp: 「ほほう、多少は揺らいだのう」
strings.en: Oho, that shook me a little.
Yes, fine Drive.
Hmm, this is getting interesting.

strings.jp: 「お主の気と力、確かに受け止めた」
strings.en: Your spirit and strength--/　I've received them in full.
Sometimes it's vital to go with the flow.

strings.jp: 「お主の血汗もやがては甘露となろうぞ」
strings.en: Your blood and sweat will one day/　turn to sweet nectar.

strings.jp: 「これもまた、道を究めるための術なり」
strings.en: This, too, is a means of mastering the Way.

strings.jp: 「ふむう……今しばらく様子を見るべきかのう」
strings.en: Hmm... Perhaps I should watch a while/　longer.

strings.jp: 「それで良い、良いぞ、青龍の操者よ」
strings.en: Yes, good, very good, pilot of Seiryu.
Pilot of Byakko, keep training.

strings.jp: 「ふむ……/　尸解すれば、天仙にまで至るかも知れんのう」
strings.en: Hmm.../　Shed your shell, and you might become/　a celestial immortal.

strings.jp: 「あくまで人として力を使うか。それも善哉」
strings.en: You'd wield your power purely as a human?/　That, too, is good.
The ancient war, once again.
This, too, is the fate of the Four Gods.
Hmm... Weaker than I expected.
Put some more Drive into it.
Hmm, did something hit me?

strings.jp: 「ワシを倒す気か。それも善哉」
strings.en: You'd defeat me? That, too, is good.

strings.jp: 「持てる力を存分に引き出すのじゃ」
strings.en: Draw out every ounce of your power.

strings.jp: 「玄武の甲羅を砕くには、力が足りぬわ」
strings.en: Not enough power to crack Genbu's shell!
Merely landing a hit won't do.
You lack discipline.

strings.jp: 「青龍の操者よ、遠慮は要らぬ」
strings.en: Seiryu's pilot, hold nothing back.

strings.jp: 「これも修行じゃ、白虎の操者よ」
strings.en: This too is Training, Byakko's pilot.

strings.jp: 「仙道に従うも良し、従わぬも良し」
strings.en: Follow the Way or don't--either is fine.

strings.jp: 「己が力と思念を、もそっと練るがよい」
strings.en: Refine your strength and will a bit more.

strings.jp: 「我が下に還るも良し、還らぬも良し」
strings.en: Return to me or not--either is fine.

strings.jp: 「四神の力は、そのようなものではあるまいて」
strings.en: The Four Gods' power is more than that.
You can't hit me.

strings.jp: 「フワッハッハッハッハッハ！」
strings.en: Fwahahahahaha!
Hold nothing back.
You lack discipline.
No effect.
Genbu's defenses are sturdy.
The shield of the divine beast!
All for naught.
That won't break the Divine Beast Shield.
So close.

strings.jp: 「これは仕方ないのう、フワッハッハッハ！」
strings.en: Well, can't be helped! Fwahahaha!

strings.jp: 「亀だけに手も足も出ぬわ、フワッハッハ！」
strings.en: Limbs tucked in like a turtle! Fwahaha!
Let it be... Splendid.
Oho, you got me there.
I'll lend a hand.
Time to do a bit of work.
Koryu, I'll lend you a hand.
Kanan, leave the rest to me.
I must fulfill my role.
Leave this to me.
I'll take the blow for you.
Koryu, leave the rest to me.
Kanan, what are you doing?
It's my role, you see.
Hmm, still able to go on?
Not running? Splendid.
Genkoudan!
Go, Genkoudan!
Fire, BuOhKi!
Kokujakou!
Black serpent, unleash your piercing light!
Take this!
BuOh Fire Lance!
Fire, BuJakuOh!
Northern Genbu, Heaven's Gate, open!
Kokuja Kyuuhou!!
Genbu, Dark Sage, drive off all demons!
Rise to the heavens!
The heavens shake to the northeast!
Heaven's Gate, open!
Genten Shouten Hou!!
